task: cross-sentence mention->antecedent resolution; 5-way candidate chain-heads; candidates shuffled so gold is not fixed at index 0

controls.negative_control: context shuffled across examples -> ~0.23 (near 0.20 chance); confirms metric is context-driven, not a surrogate
controls.lexical_control: zero-overlap subset (Jaccard target vs gold surface == 0) -> 0.49-0.57 >> chance; no lexical bridge available
controls.distance_control: gold-not-nearest subset -> 0.39-0.50 >> chance; not a proximity/first-mention heuristic
controls.note_instrument: first negative control permuted the GOLD LABEL (broken: model scores identically); corrected to context-shuffled. Earlier one-seed 0.545 figure discarded as lucky-seed behind a broken control.

verdict: Real-data, cross-sentence, ZERO-LEXICAL-OVERLAP positive: trained BERT resolver links real gold coreference beyond saliency and beyond lexical overlap; negative control fires (falls to chance).
limits: Small val (10 chapters / 244 ex, ~83% zero-overlap); 2 seeds; single corpus (LitBank); modest accuracy; not an end-to-end retrieval-headroom demo (that stays synthetic Track D). Exploratory, NO adoption, NOTHING committed.
